label: Imaging Procedure
description: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy.

verification.note: Schema node for channel-level metadata attributes in imaging. Imaging Procedure is the best available NCIT parent class.

label: Primary Key
description: The attribute selected as being most important for uniquely identifying a body of information (an entity, object or record).

verification.note: Primary Key is a direct match for a unique row identifier used as a primary key for record updates.

label: Identifier
description: A sequence of characters used to identify, name, or characterize an entity.

verification.note: Identifier (NCIT:C25364) is a direct match for the channel identifier that must match the OME-XML/TIFF header.

label: Name
description: The words or language units by which a thing is known.

verification.note: Name (NCIT:C42614) is a direct match for the channel name that must match the OME-XML/TIFF header.

label: Reagent Name
description: The name of a reagent used in a laboratory experiment.

verification.note: Reagent Name (NCIT:C178970) is a close match for antibody name. The parent of ChIP-Seq Antibody Name (NCIT:C177613). Partial match as it is more general than an antibody-specific name.

label: Research Resource Identifier
description: A persistent and unique identifier for referencing a research resource. Examples of resources include antibodies, cell lines, core facilities, and organisms.

verification.note: Research Resource Identifier is a direct match for the Channel Resource ID field (e.g. RRID: AB_394606).

label: Fluorochrome Dye
description: A class of dyes when excited by light of certain wavelengths, emit photons and become fluorescent. Fluorescence gives fluorochromes imaging characteristics and are used to label or stain biological structures.

verification.note: Fluorochrome Dye (NCIT:C503) is a direct match for the fluorescent dye label (e.g. Alexa Fluor 488) used in the imaging channel.

label: Reagent Lot Number
description: The lot number of the reagent.

verification.note: Reagent Lot Number (NCIT:C112406) is a direct match for the lot number of the antibody from the vendor.

label: Manufacturer
description: A person, enterprise, or entity that produces finished goods.

verification.note: Manufacturer (NCIT:C25392) is the closest NCIT match for antibody vendor/supplier. Partial match as vendor encompasses both manufacturer and distributor.

label: Catalog Number
description: The identifier assigned to a product, usually in the list of products published by a reseller or manufacturer.

verification.note: Catalog Number (NCIT:C99286) is a direct match for the antibody catalog number.

label: Excitation Wavelength
description: The electromagnetic radiation wavelength that causes peak excitation of a chemical compound.

verification.note: Excitation Wavelength (NCIT:C204095) is a direct match for the center/peak of the excitation spectrum (nm).

label: Emission Wavelength
description: The wavelength with the maximum peak in an emission spectrum.

verification.note: Emission Wavelength (NCIT:C204101) is a direct match for the center/peak of the emission spectrum (nm).

label: Element
description: A substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means; all atoms of an element have the same number of protons.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for element symbol/abbreviation. Element (NCIT:C1940) represents the concept of a chemical element. Partial match for the metal element abbreviation (e.g. La, Nd).

label: Isotope
description: A form of a chemical element containing a specific number of neutrons and a specific atomic mass.

verification.note: Isotope (NCIT:C47933) is a direct match for the element mass number/isotope of the metal used in mass cytometry channels.
